mapper.select: select ti.id as trackId, ti.track_title, ti.media_duration, ti.order_num, ti.create_time, max(if(ts.stat_type = '0701', ts.stat_num, 0)) as playStatNum, max(if(ts.stat_type = '0704', ts.stat_num, 0)) as commentStatNum from track_info ti inner join track_stat ts on ts.track_id = ti.id where ti.album_id = #{albumId} and ti.status = '0501' and ti.is_deleted = 0 group by ti.id order by ti.order_num asc
